snippet.title: Tiny Tengu Tactics Intro
snippet.description:
This is a very early version of our little battler. You'll play as a Tengu Captain and be in charge of recruiting mercenaries and taking on contracts to save the villagers from cute, giant monsters.

It's made in Unity by a small dev based in Kyoto: https://neko-logic.com/

We hope you enjoy it!
